text:
maria: dropping a new idea a combined "focus + sampling" control for the latency heatmap. goal: let users temporarily increase temporal resolution AND apply a smoothing sample in one flow. opening for quick takes. :mag: chetan: neat. two quick UX Qs: 1) does focus change the data aggregation or only the view? 2) how do we show that sampling alters plotted density but not stored metrics? yara: answer Q1: view-only. we shouldn't touch stored aggregates. Q2: microcopy under control: 'View-only: changes visual aggregation. Raw metrics unchanged.' short and visible. a11y-bot: accessibility checklist: the combined control must expose clear aria-labels for both modes, keyboard shortcut to toggle focus, and a live-region announcing when sampling percent changes. tooltips dismissible with ESC. maria: interaction thought: primary control = toggle 'Focus (high res)'. when on, a compact row appears: "Bucket: [3] Sample: [25%] Reset". presets available: 10 / 25 / 50 / 100. pressing Tab should land on presets first. chetan: visual: when focus active, dim original heatmap to 35% and overlay focused heatmap with pattern fill for baseline to aid perception. keep p95 line on top with higher z-index and stroke variants (solid vs dotted). yara: copy tweaks: rename 'Sample' to 'Sampling (visual)'. add a hover-info: 'Sampling reduces point density for clearer trends; increases noise smoothing.' also show exact percent numeric next to slider. a11y-bot: ensure the pattern fill is programmatically described (aria-describedby) and the presets have aria-pressed states. Add a screen-reader note: 'Focus mode enabled: temporal resolution increased, sampling set to X percent.' maria: implementation hint for eng: minimal HTML: ```html
``` small CSS note: use `stroke-dasharray: 4 3` for dotted p95 line and include `pattern` defs for baseline overlay. chetan: analytics: emit events focus_mode_toggled and sampling_changed with anonymized route/cohort keys and percent. don't include raw metric values. store only aggregated deltas for suggestion engine. yara: one more UX safety: show a small ephemeral badge near chart title when focus/sampling is non-default: 'Focus · 25% sample' with link to 'Revert'. helps users know view is modified. a11y-bot: final test plan: keyboard walkthrough (toggle, presets, reset), screen-reader announcement checks, high-contrast and reduced-motion verifications, ensure ESC dismisses tooltips. maria: thanks all 496 will iterate mocks with compact preset pills, pattern overlay, numeric sample display, and the revert badge. will post v2 tomorrow.
